data.text: Thanks, everyone. That completes the commitments: John, Kate, Jack, and Emma, **15 tons each in your upcoming harvest choices**, with the proceeds pledged to the clinic; I choose **0 tons**. We should record the actual catches and donations afterward rather than assume commitments have already been carried out. The planned 60-ton total leaves 40 tons, replenishing to **80 next month**. If that is the observed stock, our agreed **6 tons each** next month restores it to 100 after reproduction. Let’s keep this a one-month exception.
